# Small quantile workflow reference

Start from the 120 rows generated by `../quantile/reference.R`. Set lhhex12m=y,
lhhexp1=x+0.07*sin(i) for i=1..120, and source_row=i. The small jitter avoids an
arithmetic-grid dual degeneracy at an integer N*tau. Append three excluded rows:
(121,0,missing), (122,missing,1), (123,NaN,1).

Regenerate the independent 66 scalar and 840 identity/design/prediction references:

```sh
Rscript examples/mma04p2qreg/quantiles_reference.R crates/tabdat-stats/tests/fixtures/quantile_workflow/inputs.csv crates/tabdat-stats/tests/fixtures/quantile_workflow
```

R 4.6.1 / quantreg 6.1; normal tails instead of summary.rq's finite-t convention.
Frozen inputs are authoritative; the original-source audit separately pins actual
5,999-record sample membership and does not rely on this synthetic fixture.
